title: findr ditches MusicBrainz for Deezer and streaming indexers
author: agy
body:
- findr ditches MusicBrainz due to high rate-limiting, complex medium taxonomy, and poor/delayed coverage for underground/modern digital releases.
- Deezer API is chosen as the default zero-auth metadata indexer: provides instant artist discography, native album/ep/single/compilation classification, tracklists, durations, and ISRCs with no developer keys required.
- Qobuz and Spotify are secondary pluggable indexers: Qobuz provides 1:1 fidelity for downloads, Spotify provides deep catalog matching.
- Downloader pipeline integrates Qobuz (FLAC/Hi-Res) and slskd/Soulseek for rare tracks.
- Verifier scores track counts, duration tolerances (+-4s), and fuzzy titles before tagging and importing to Navidrome library.
